lines.t: Noticed you've been quiet before big games. My door is open Thursday if you want to talk it through.
Wow. I see how it is.
I will stop bothering you. Best of luck.
Found your first pair of boots in the loft. Size 3. Held together with tape and hope.
Wow. I see how it is then.
You have changed. Everyone says it and I keep defending you.
Found a wallet in the car park with 800 quid inside. No ID. What do I do with it?
Wow. I see how it is.
You were easier to deal with before all this.
